Lemma
[second countability from a partition of unity]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-6-sigmacompact-core ↗ thm:dc-ch0-5-6

1. ch0:5.6Let $M$ be a connected manifold charted over a second-countable model $H$. If $M$ carries a locally finite open cover by $\sigma $-compact sets — in particular, the coordinate neighborhoods $\{ V_\alpha \} $ of a differentiable partition of unity, which are locally finite, cover $M$, and are each homeomorphic to an open subset of $\mathbb {R}^n$ (hence $\sigma $-compact) — then $M$ has a countable basis.
Proof

\sketch

By section 4 the manifold $M$ is $\sigma $-compact. A charted space over a second-countable model that is $\sigma $-compact is itself second countable (cover each of the countably many compacts by finitely many chart domains and use the countable basis of $H$ inside each). Applying this argument to each connected component gives the second-countability conclusion in the theorem.

□
